headline: You’re losing money by increasing size after a loss

size_up_after_loss.why_it_matters: Increasing your entry size after a loss cost you ₹1,05,732. The after‑loss trades had a median entry size of ₹12,562 versus ₹6,578 otherwise, and a win rate of 28% compared with 39% elsewhere.
size_up_after_loss.rule: After a loss, your next entry is your usual size.

averaging_down.note: Averaging down is showing up and may be worth watching.

closing: Try applying this rule in the coming month.
